limits: Native execution covered Linux arm64 with OpenBKN 0.2.2 main builds on a local kind cluster (sample service 022-9e2d8d18; bkn-backend was redeployed to main-2eed547 by other work during the run); no native amd64 certification and no released vanilla 0.2.2.
Display names were read back from the platform: 240 properties and 73 relations named in the sample's language, the rules and adjustments toolboxes with their functions, no ID-style toolbox left.

The four rule functions are mounted on the network and were called through Context Loader execute_tool and through the toolbox proxy the Workshop schedule Gantt uses; every check result matched the same code run locally on the package fixtures.

The two adjust actions were executed through Context Loader (get_action_info, execute_action, get_action_execution); their writes were read back with Cypher and then restored. Installing again restores the package schedule.
Reference queries, graph patterns, functions and actions were checked through APIs; no model answered the questions, and the Workshop app is not part of this version.

The first zh-CN fresh installation of this package failed in its verify stage because the operator's sign-in token expired during the run; that failed installation was uninstalled through the sample service (the early ownership receipt of this version) and a new fresh installation passed. It was not a retry of the same installation.
